strings.name: N. R. Narayana Murthy
strings.summary: After studying electrical engineering, Murthy worked on computing systems at IIM Ahmedabad, followed by overseas work and early ventures. With six partners he founded Infosys, developing international software delivery, engineer training and corporate governance. A longtime company leader, he briefly returned as executive chairman in 2013 and left the board in 2014, continuing to discuss education, enterprise and work culture.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founding Infosys advanced India's software services and global technology outsourcing, influencing digital skills and entrepreneurship.
strings.facts.f1.label: Region of education
strings.facts.f1.value: Studied engineering in Mysore, Karnataka, then continued in Kanpur.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Electrical engineering degree, National Institute of Engineering (1967); master's, IIT Kanpur (1969).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Building a software services company
strings.highlights.h1.text: With co-founders, he connected Indian engineering teams with international clients.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Global delivery and skills
strings.highlights.h2.text: He promoted distributed development, engineer training and management for international markets.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Institutional memory and leadership
strings.timeline.t1.text: At an IIM Bangalore book event, he discussed leaders' example and organizational values.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Responding to long-hours debate
strings.timeline.t2.text: After controversy over his 70-hour-week proposal, he said long hours should be a personal choice, not imposed on others.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Leaving Infosys's board
strings.timeline.t3.text: His non-executive chairmanship ended; the annual report also records that he declined a proposed chairman-emeritus title.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Returning to leadership
strings.timeline.t4.text: Appointed executive chairman, he re-entered management during business transformation.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Infosys lists on Nasdaq
strings.timeline.t5.text: The company he led entered US capital markets, increasing international visibility.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Co-founding Infosys
strings.timeline.t6.text: With six software professionals, he established a company serving overseas customers.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Master's and systems work
strings.timeline.t7.text: After IIT Kanpur, he joined IIM Ahmedabad as chief systems programmer.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Engineering degree completed
strings.timeline.t8.text: He graduated from the National Institute of Engineering in Mysore, preparing for computing and software work.
